[package]
name = "nvml-wrapper"
version = "0.12.1"
authors = [ "Cldfire",]
description = "A safe and ergonomic Rust wrapper for the NVIDIA Management Library"
readme = "../README.md"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/nvml-wrapper"
repository = "https://github.com/Cldfire/nvml-wrapper"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.60.0"
keywords = [ "nvidia", "gpu", "managment", "monitoring", "hardware",]
categories = [ "api-bindings", "hardware-support",]

[features]
default = []
legacy-functions = [ "nvml-wrapper-sys/legacy-functions",]
serde = [ "dep:serde", "dep:serde_derive", "bitflags/serde",]

[dependencies]
thiserror = "1.0"
bitflags = "2.4.0"
wrapcenum-derive = "0.4.1"
libloading = "0.8.1"
static_assertions = "1.1"

[dev-dependencies]
pretty-bytes = "0.2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_derive]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.nvml-wrapper-sys]
version = "0.9.1"
path = "../nvml-wrapper-sys"

[package]
name = "nvml-wrapper-sys"
version = "0.9.1"
authors = [ "Cldfire",]
description = "Generated bindings to the NVIDIA Management Library."
readme = "README.md"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/nvml-wrapper-sys"
repository = "https://github.com/Cldfire/nvml-wrapper"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.60.0"
keywords = [ "nvidia", "gpu", "managment", "monitoring", "hardware",]
categories = [ "external-ffi-bindings", "hardware-support",]
exclude = [ "nvml.h",]

[dependencies]
libloading = "0.8.1"

[features]
default = []
legacy-functions = []

[package]
name = "zbus_polkit"
version = "5.0.0"
authors = [ "Marc-André Lureau <marcandre.lureau@redhat.com>", "Zeeshan Ali Khan <zeenix@gmail.com>",]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.64"
description = "PolicyKit binding"
repository = "https://github.com/z-galaxy/zbus_polkit/"
keywords = [ "D-Bus", "DBus", "IPC",]
license = "MIT"
categories = [ "os::unix-apis",]
readme = "README.md"

[features]
default = [ "zbus/async-io", "blocking-api",]
tokio = [ "zbus/tokio",]
blocking-api = [ "zbus/blocking-api",]

[dependencies]
serde_repr = "0.1.19"
static_assertions = "1.1.0"

[dev-dependencies]
byteorder = "1.5.0"

[dependencies.zbus]
version = "5.0.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.200"
features = [ "derive",]

[dependencies.enumflags2]
version = "0.7.9"
features = [ "serde",]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = [ "macros", "rt",]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/rust-nvml/nvml-wrapper"]
git = "https://github.com/rust-nvml/nvml-wrapper"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "eb47417eede43443f139053479618e96ad32893d"

[source."https://github.com/ilya-zlobintsev/zbus_polkit"]
git = "https://github.com/ilya-zlobintsev/zbus_polkit"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "fix-uid-type"
